notes: Corrected s018/s019: the accepted alignment gave who to the article under rule 90, but rule 90 says in terms that it blesses no unit in which a head noun is expressed, and θεῷ is expressed. Rule 31's expressed-head-noun test therefore decides it — the article is unrepresented and who is the participle's helper. This also matches 1TH.2.12's τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ καλοῦντος → God who calleth, which is rule 24's habit.
The remaining articles are decided separately: s005 unrepresented for want of a determiner (rules 21, 23), s020 unrepresented by displacement (rule 20).
καθώς takes even as whole under rule 82; no καί stands in the verse for the bare-even gloss to answer to, and οὕτως keeps its own so.
